speaker: Rajesh
text: Okay, if no one else will say it, I will. We really suck at paintball.

speaker: Howard
text: That was absolutely humiliating. Yes, but you don't have to lose to Kyle Bernstein's bar mitzvah party.

text: Oh, come on. Some battles you win, some battles you lose. I think we have to acknowledge, those were some fairly savage pre-adolescent Jews.

text: No, we were annihilated by our own incompetence and the inability of some people to follow the chain of command. No, I want to talk about the fact that Wolowitz shot me in the back.

text: Sheldon, you ready?

text: Sure, if you consider being fragged by your own troops fun. You clear space on your calendar. There will be an inquiry.
